0.$description: No gap. For removing padding or a gap explicitly.

50.$description: The tightest gap, between parts of one element, such as a badge and its dot.

100.$description: Gap between closely related items, such as an icon and its text in small controls.

200.$description: Default gap between an icon and its label, and between items in a compact group.

300.$description: Padding inside small controls and badges; gap between items in a list.

400.$description: Default padding inside components, and the gap between related elements.

500.$description: Padding inside medium containers such as alerts, menus, and popovers.

600.$description: Padding inside cards and modals; gap between groups within a component.

800.$description: The largest component-level gap, between sections inside a card or modal. For larger gaps, use layout/*.

100.$description: Gap between sections of a page. The smallest layout step; below it, use space/*.

200.$description: Gap between major page regions, such as the header and the content.

300.$description: The largest page gap, around page sections and hero areas.
